task_text: Pendulum energy relay: A passive pendulum (a rod with a ball-shaped bob) hangs between the two arms, each of which holds a flat paddle. The left arm must actively push the pendulum so that it swings out toward the right arm. The right arm must meet it and brake it, then actively drive it back so that it swings out toward the left arm, no longer touching it. The left arm must then touch it again, and the pendulum must end up hanging almost straight down and almost still, and stay that way for one second. Phases, in order: left_excitation: the left paddle (any part of panda-0's tool link) touches the pendulum while that tool's centre-of-mass speed is above 0.03 m/s (an active push, recorded once); after that, the pendulum swings out toward the right arm beyond `minimum_excursion` = 0.18 rad (about 10.3 deg) from straight down, i.e. hinge angle q < -0.18 rad, bob displaced toward +x. The paddle may or may not still be touching the pendulum at that moment.; right_braking: the right paddle (any part of panda-1's tool link) touches the pendulum at a moment when the pendulum's angular speed about its hinge is below 0.45 rad/s.; right_return_impulse: the right paddle touches the pendulum while that tool's centre-of-mass speed is above 0.03 m/s (an active push, recorded once in this phase); after that, at a moment when the right paddle is not touching the pendulum, the pendulum is beyond `return_excursion` = 0.12 rad (about 6.9 deg) toward the left arm (q > 0.12 rad, bob displaced toward -x) and is still swinging further toward the left arm at more than 0.25 rad/s (dq/dt > +0.25 rad/s).; left_recovery: the left paddle touches the pendulum (any contact).; low_energy_hold: the pendulum is within 0.055 rad (about 3.2 deg) of hanging straight down (|q| < 0.055 rad) and its angular speed is below 0.12 rad/s, for 1.0 s without interruption. Paddle contact with the pendulum is allowed during the hold. This completes the task.
